snippet.title: 2026 Total Solar Eclipse (Official NASA Trailer)
snippet.description:
The Sun and Moon are coming together to put on a show for Earth, and we'll be sharing it with you.

On Aug. 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will be visible in parts of Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and a small corner of Portugal.

Viewers in other places in the Northern Hemisphere will also have the chance to experience a partial solar eclipse, including parts of the U.S. (from Alaska to North Carolina), most of Canada, much of Europe, and northwestern Africa.

We'll be broadcasting the eclipse live, so you can experience totality from anywhere.

Learn how to watch totality live with us: https://go.nasa.gov/4ftKdXd
Learn more about this solar spectacle: https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/total-solar-eclipse-on-august-12-2026/

Credit: NASA

snippet.description:

Mais un incendie survient pendant le bac blanc, et on l’accuse d’en être à l’origine… Exclu de son lycée, il doit quitter son quartier et aller dans le seul établissement qui l’accepte : le pensionnat catholique de Saint-Albert-le-Grand, en Bourgogne. Entre choc des cultures et quête de rédemption, Ilyes va devoir surmonter ses préjugés… Et ceux des autres.

snippet.title: Mafia: The Omertà Collection - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Experience four eras of organized crime in Mafia: The Omertà Collection, a new bundle featuring all four Mafia games and current-generation updates to Mafia: Definitive Edition, including 60 FPS and technical improvements.

Mafia: Definitive Edition comes to PlayStation 5 tomorrow, August 14, 2026.

Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor expansion and Deluxe content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition, including the PS5® version with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition, including all DLC

Step into the shoes of men bound to the Family across decades of mob history in these immersive, third-person action-adventures rich with cinematic storytelling.

Each game in the critically acclaimed Mafia series lets you live the life of a gangster in stunningly detailed, period-accurate environments. Embrace the power and respect earned through loyalty to the Family. Endure the hardships and betrayals that define these unforgiving criminal underworlds. 

When you swear the oath to become a made-man, you commit your life to Omertà, a code of honor and silence that demands everything and forgives nothing. Do every job that's asked of you. Take what you're owed. And eliminate anyone who stands in your way...all for the Family.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: THE OLD COUNTRY - DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------
Sicily, 1904. Uncover the origins of organized crime as you fight to survive and prove your worth to the Family. After a brutal childhood of forced labor, Enzo Favara will risk everything to become a man of honor in the Torrisi crime family. His oath to the Mafia, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth: Family Takes Sacrifice.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: THE OLD COUNTRY - MAN OF HONOR DLC
-------------------------------------------------
Sicily, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his. At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the Valle Dorata's volatile underworld, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

-------------------------------------------------
MAFIA: DEFINITIVE EDITION
-------------------------------------------------

Ce n'est pas qu'une autobiographie. C'est une confession.

Verity, avec Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson et Josh Hartnett, exclusivement au cinéma le 30 septembre.

Adapté du best-seller de Colleen Hoover, ce thriller psychologique suit Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway), autrice à succès, et Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), romancière en difficulté qui s’installe dans la propriété isolée des Crawford pour devenir la prête-plume de Verity. Lorsque Lowen met la main sur ce qui semble être les notes autobiographiques glaçantes de Verity, elle se retrouve confrontée à des confessions aussi dérangeantes que perverses sur Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), le mari de Verity, et peine dès lors à démêler la fiction de la réalité, la vérité du mensonge, la curiosité de l’obsession.
